notes.rust: Bucket operations, object metadata updates and deletes, listings, rewrites and composes go through the StorageControl gRPC client (UpdateBucket and UpdateObject with field masks, never PATCH), because google-cloud-storage 1.22.0 has no JSON metadata API; uploads, downloads and signed requests use JSON and XML. A 412, 404 or 403 may therefore arrive as the matching gRPC status.

variants.go: Go's public ObjectAttrsToUpdate cannot delete one key: a PATCH merges the supplied keys and only an empty map, sent as null, clears them all. Go checks that the merge keeps every key and that the empty map clears the map.
variants.rust: UpdateObject with the masks content_type, metadata.a and metadata.c: a masked key absent from the update is deleted.
